sources.name: Registrų centras — JAR (Register of Legal Entities) public search
sources.verdict: VERIFIED. Free public search by name or 9-digit code; limit 100 searches/day with captcha; detailed extracts paid/contract-based. The canonical company registry.

sources.name: Registrų centras — JAR pirminiai duomenys (raw open data)
sources.verdict: URL verified to exist (301 target of registrucentras.lt/p/1094); page body is JS-rendered so contents not machine-read this session. Known route for periodic JAR raw-data bulk files (legal form, status, address, NACE). Top-priority ingest.

sources.name: Registrų centras — JADIS (participants/shareholders information system)
sources.verdict: Real RC subsystem holding UAB shareholder lists; exact URL not verified this session and public access is largely paid/self-service. Do not assume open UBO access (EU restriction applies).

sources.name: Bank of Lithuania — Financial Market Participants directory
sources.verdict: VERIFIED. Searchable directory of all supervised participants: banks/specialised banks, EMIs, PIs, insurers, management companies, AIFMs, CIUs, crowdfunding operators, consumer-credit providers, currency exchange; 15+ named sub-lists; includes sanctions and dispute counts. MiCA CASP licensees also surface here. lb.lt intermittently 403s automated fetchers — crawl politely from EU IP.

sources.name: ESMA registers (AIFMs, UCITS, MiCA CASPs — Lithuania filter)
sources.verdict: Not fetched this session but a stable, well-known EU register hub with open downloads; useful cross-check/backup for LT AIFMs and CASP passporting when lb.lt blocks.

sources.name: TAR — Teisės aktų registras (e-tar, official gazette successor)
sources.verdict: Site exists but returned 403 to our fetcher (both /portal/en and /portal/lt). TAR replaced Valstybės žinios in 2014 as the official register of legal acts. Verify access from EU IP.

sources.name: Registrų centras — JAR vieši pranešimai (legal-entity public notices)
sources.verdict: RC publishes statutory company notices (liquidation, reorganisation, capital reduction) — the gazette-equivalent for corporate events. Exact path not verified this session; RC domain itself is reachable.

sources.name: LITEKO — public court decisions search
sources.verdict: The official public search of Lithuanian court decisions (incl. insolvency rulings). Not verified this session (teismai.lt domain 403'd our fetcher); URL is the long-standing known route.

sources.name: eTeismai.lt — court decisions aggregator
sources.verdict: VERIFIED. Free public database of Lithuanian court decisions searchable by case number, plus codes and court directory. Useful fallback to LITEKO.

sources.name: Teismai.lt — National Courts Administration portal
sources.verdict: Official courts portal (hearings, insolvency case announcements, court news). Returned 403 to our fetcher; site is real — verify from EU IP.

sources.name: AVNT — Authority of Audit, Accounting, Property Valuation and Insolvency Management
sources.verdict: Returned 403 to our fetcher but is the real statutory home of: insolvency administrators roll, corporate insolvency process data/statistics, and the certified property & business valuers register (the local RICS-equivalent roll). Critical for Private Debt/NPL coverage; harvest from EU IP.

sources.name: e-varžytynės / eAukcionai — state e-auction portal
sources.verdict: VERIFIED (302 to eaukcionai.lt/evs/). Public list of bailiff and insolvency auctions (real estate, vehicles, other assets), run by Ministry of Justice/RC/bailiffs chamber. Strong distressed-asset signal source.

sources.name: Nasdaq Baltic — share/issuer lists (Vilnius incl.)
sources.verdict: VERIFIED. Baltic Main/Secondary/First North lists in HTML tables with explicit XLSX downloads; Vilnius issuers flagged VLN.

sources.name: Nasdaq Baltic — market news / issuer disclosures
sources.verdict: VERIFIED. Company announcements across Tallinn/Riga/Vilnius with filterable archive (/statistics/en/news/archive) and email subscription; no RSS link found on page.

sources.name: Nasdaq Baltic — member firms list
sources.verdict: Standard Nasdaq Baltic statistics route for exchange members (brokers); this exact path not fetched this session, sibling pages verified.

sources.name: Nasdaq CSD — issuers/securities statistics (Lithuania)
sources.verdict: VERIFIED. Baltic central securities depository; publishes securities and issuer lists per market (>6,800 issuers), participant lists, settlement statistics.

sources.name: LT VCA — Lithuanian Private Equity & Venture Capital Association members
sources.verdict: VERIFIED page exists; 64 members, €3B AUM, €1.6B dry powder stated on homepage. Members page is a logo grid — names live in link hrefs/alt attributes, not visible text; extract from anchors or follow logo links. Categories: full (funds), associate (advisors/law firms/banks), honorary.

sources.name: LBA — Association of Lithuanian Banks
sources.verdict: VERIFIED. 11 member banks (Swedbank, SEB, Luminor, Citadele...) + associate members listed; sector statistics and news published.

sources.name: Lithuanian Insurers Association (Lietuvos draudikų asociacija)
sources.verdict: VERIFIED. 11 member insurers listed by name (Balcia, BTA, Compensa, ERGO, If, Lietuvos draudimas, Gjensidige...).

sources.name: LIPFA — Lithuanian Investment and Pension Funds Association
sources.verdict: VERIFIED. Publishes 2nd/3rd-pillar AUM and client statistics (€6.7B / €0.65B); member roster not on homepage — pension managers themselves are in the LB FMP directory. Key LP-side context.

sources.name: LFA — Fintech Hub LT / Lithuanian Fintech Association
sources.verdict: VERIFIED (fintechhub.lt 301s here). Unites licensed fintechs (EMIs/PIs/specialised banks); members & sponsors section plus newsroom.

sources.name: LNTPA — Lithuanian Real Estate Development Association
sources.verdict: VERIFIED. Developer members section (new joiners announced in news), market news, market reviews. Core Real Assets entity source.

sources.name: Unicorns Lithuania — startup association
sources.verdict: Real association of Lithuanian startups/scale-ups; returned 403 to our fetcher this session — retry from EU IP.

sources.name: Invest Lithuania (investment promotion agency)
sources.verdict: VERIFIED. Publishes downloadable sector reports incl. 'Fintech Overview 2025–2026' and Business Services Sector Overview — good curated entity lists for fintech/service-graph; news section, no RSS found.

sources.name: Innovation Agency Lithuania
sources.verdict: VERIFIED. National innovation agency (successor of Enterprise Lithuania functions; verslilietuva.lt cert now broken). Publishes news, startup ecosystem resources, export tools.

sources.name: Startup Lithuania — startup database
sources.verdict: VERIFIED. 1,190 startups / 958 funding rounds — but the database is Dealroom-powered (white-label). HARD RULE: do not scrape the Dealroom-embedded database; use it for market-map orientation and go to registries/press for facts.

sources.name: INVEGA — national promotional institution
sources.verdict: Real (state guarantee/VC-fund-of-funds body; publishes selected financial intermediaries — accelerators, VC funds under state programmes). 403 to our fetcher; also check consolidation into ILTE.

sources.name: ILTE — national development bank
sources.verdict: Lithuania's national development institution (consolidating INVEGA/VIPA functions). 403 to our fetcher this session; verify structure and intermediary lists from EU IP.

sources.name: Turto bankas — state asset bank
sources.verdict: Real state enterprise managing/selling state property (privatization-adjacent). Connection refused to our fetcher (likely geo-block); verify from EU IP.

sources.name: CVP IS — Central public procurement portal
sources.verdict: VERIFIED. Tender search with CPV/procedure filters; no API mentioned on page (procurement open datasets exist via VPT/data.gov.lt routes).

sources.name: VPT — Public Procurement Office
sources.verdict: Real authority publishing procurement statistics/open data; lrv.lt government domains 403'd our fetcher across the board — verify from EU IP.

sources.name: Lithuanian Bar Association (Lietuvos advokatūra)
sources.verdict: VERIFIED homepage; statutory advocate roll exists but the public search route was not visible on the homepage fetched — locate the advocate-search subpage when harvesting.

sources.name: Lithuanian Chamber of Auditors (Lietuvos auditorių rūmai) — lists
sources.verdict: VERIFIED lar.lt with 'Sąrašai' (lists) section at this path — public auditor/audit-firm rolls for the service graph.

sources.name: Lithuanian Chamber of Bailiffs (Antstolių rūmai)
sources.verdict: Real chamber with public bailiff directory (enforcement/NPL relevance); not fetched this session.

sources.name: RICS firms directory (covers Lithuania)
sources.verdict: RICS-regulated firm search covering LT; global RICS route, no local chapter directory. Pair with AVNT's national valuers register. Not fetched this session.

sources.name: EUTL — EU ETS Union Registry (Lithuanian accounts)
sources.verdict: Stable, well-known EU transaction log; filter operator/trading accounts by Lithuania. Not re-fetched this session; publicly parseable with bulk views.

sources.name: data.gov.lt — Lithuanian open data portal
sources.verdict: National open-data portal with catalog API; hosts company, procurement, Sodra and insolvency-adjacent datasets. 403 to our fetcher this session — real, retry from EU IP.

sources.name: Sodra — open data (atvira.sodra.lt)
sources.verdict: Known monthly employer-level open datasets (insured employee counts, average wage, social-insurance debts) — excellent deterministic enrichment for every LT entity. 403 to our fetcher this session; real and free.

sources.name: Official Statistics Portal (osp.stat.gov.lt) + API
sources.verdict: State Data Agency portal with REST/PxWeb API and business-register statistics. 403 to our fetcher this session; real and free.

sources.verdict: Lithuania's principal business daily (also runs rekvizitai.vz.lt company directory). Domain refuses our fetcher entirely; /rss returned 404 — RSS endpoint unconfirmed, likely paywalled content. Headline+link discipline only.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Thin, fund-level Baltic coverage: LT VCA-member funds (BaltCap, Livonia, Practica, Iron Wolf, Coinvest et al.) with AUM/vintages; weak below fund level and on service graph.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: Bank of Lithuania AIFM/CIU register, LT VCA statistics and member list, EIF/InvestEU press releases, fund websites — all directly accessible to us.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Deal-level LT VC/PE coverage, decent on rounds and exits; company financials thin (relies on registry re-sellers).
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: Press releases (vz.lt, 15min, Baltic Times), Nasdaq Baltic disclosures, JAR filings via aggregators, Startup Lithuania announcements.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Strongest startup/VC coverage of Lithuania — it literally powers the official Startup Lithuania database (white-label), so its LT data is quasi-official. HARD RULE: do not scrape Dealroom or the embedded database.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: Startup Lithuania submissions, Innovation Agency data, funding-round press, registry legal-form data — we go to Startup Lithuania news, press RSS, and JAR directly.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Patchy self-reported LT startup profiles; funding data lags Dealroom; no NPL/real-assets/service-graph coverage.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: Company self-submissions and TechCrunch-style press — the underlying LT press (15min, vz.lt, Made in Vilnius) is directly accessible.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Minimal Lithuania coverage; occasional fintech-market mentions only.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: Invest Lithuania fintech reports, Bank of Lithuania licensing statistics — both public.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: LOCAL. The de-facto public company directory of Lithuania: profiles, financial summaries, employees, debts. Blocks scrapers; commercial re-use restricted.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: JAR raw open data (Registrų centras), RC financial statements, Sodra open data (employees/wages/debts) — we ingest those primary routes at $0 instead.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: LOCAL. Lithuanian company-data/credit-risk API startup (freemium), LT+LV coverage, sells API access.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: JAR bulk data, Sodra open data, court/insolvency records (LITEKO/AVNT), procurement data — all public primaries listed in this catalog.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: LOCAL. Incumbent credit bureau; company reports, scoring, debtor registry; LBA associate member.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: JAR, Sodra, courts, plus proprietary bank payment data (not replicable, and we don't need it).

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: LOCAL. Lithuanian credit-scoring/company-monitoring provider built on open registers.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: JAR raw data, Sodra open data, insolvency data — same public primaries we catalog above.

searchedButAbsent: Caveat: this session's WebSearch budget was already exhausted (200/200) before this task started, so discovery ran on domain knowledge plus direct URL verification via fetch; 54 real sources catalogued, ~28 fetch-verified. Many Lithuanian state domains (e-tar.lt, avnt.lt, teismai.lt, all *.lrv.lt, data.gov.lt, osp.stat.gov.lt, atvira.sodra.lt, invega.lt, ilte.lt, turtas.lt) returned 403/refused to the US-based fetcher — they are real and known-good but need harvesting from an EU IP; marked honestly per row. Searched-for but absent or subsumed: (1) Valstybės žinios — ceased 2014, fully replaced by TAR (e-tar.lt); (2) no separate fund-administrator licensee list — fund administration falls inside the Bank of Lithuania FMP directory categories; (3) no standalone MiCA/crypto register — CASP authorisations sit inside the same LB FMP directory (the pre-MiCA 'crypto operator' JAR-notification list was retired); (4) no Lithuanian NPL-servicer or debt-purchaser association exists (servicers appear via LB consumer-credit/credit-servicer lists); (5) no litigation-funding association or local funder of note; (6) no local RICS chapter directory — only the global ricsfirms.com search plus AVNT's national valuers roll; (7) an independent Lithuanian leasing association could not be confirmed as currently operating (leasing statistics are published by LBA and Bank of Lithuania); (8) RSS endpoints for vz.lt, delfi.lt, lrt.lt and madeinvilnius.lt could not be confirmed because those domains block automated fetchers — only 15min.lt and baltictimes.com feeds were positively verified working.
